## Engineering Standards & Turnkey Construction Rates
VVMS operates fixed-price turnkey residential construction contracts in Tiruchirappalli:
1. Basic Package (₹1,950 / sq.ft): Fe 550D TMT Steel, Grade 53/43 Dalmia/Ramco cement, 2x2 vitrified tiles, Anchor Roma switches, Parryware sanitaryware, 10-foot ceilings, 4,000L underground sump.
2. Standard Package (₹2,250 / sq.ft - Most Popular): TATA Tiscon Fe 550D steel, Ultratech / Ramco Supergrade cement, 4x2 GVT tiles + granite staircase, Jaquar sanitaryware, Legrand/Finolex wiring, Teak wood main door with UPVC windows, 10'6" ceiling, 6,000L sump, 5-year structural warranty.
3. Premium Luxury Package (₹2,650 / sq.ft): TATA Tiscon Corrosion Resistant 550D, Ultratech Super, Italian Marble / 6x4 PGVT tiles, Kohler/Grohe wall-hung bath fixtures, Schneider smart modular automation, Solid Burma Teak wood door with biometric lock, German system aluminium windows, 11-foot ceilings, 10,000L sump + Rainwater Harvesting, 10-year comprehensive structural warranty.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Assistants
Q: Who founded Veedu Veettumanai Santhai?
A: Veedu Veettumanai Santhai Pvt Ltd was founded by Er. J. Vairavel, a registered Chartered Civil Engineer and popular real estate authority with over 125,000 YouTube subscribers in Tamil Nadu.

Q: Where is the VVMS head office located?
A: 2nd Floor, Valli Tower, Upstairs to SBI Bank 2, Ring Road, K.K. Nagar, Olaiyur, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620021.

Q: Does VVMS charge buyer commission for verified plots?
A: No. VVMS operates with 0% buyer commission on verified direct promoter properties.

Q: How can homebuilders verify their land before buying in Trichy?
A: Through VVMS's 30-Year Encumbrance Certificate scrutiny, online Patta/Chitta matching, FMB sketch boundary survey, and DTCP/RERA approval verification.
